Q5217.reason: CIF already allocates loading costs to the seller, so the $50/thousand loading charge is part of the offered $1,000 price rather than a new term, making the confirmation an acceptance and not a counteroffer.

Q8260.reason: Without oxygen the electron transport chain stalls, NAD+ regeneration stops, and the NAD+-dependent Krebs cycle halts, so oxaloacetate production ends, while glycolysis keeps making ATP and pyruvate.

Q5585.reason: A lay witness may give an estimated speed opinion once shown adequate opportunity to observe and enough driving experience to estimate vehicle speed.
